title: Свадебный банкет и хэппи-энд  (The Wedding Banquet and a Happy Ending)

scenes.title: Борьба за место и отказ переезжать  (Fighting for His Place and Refusing to Move In)
scenes.summary: Max vows to do anything to win back his job at Claude Monet, while at Elena's apartment Chef Barinov tries to fix an appliance and refuses to move in with her.

scenes.title: Мужские принципы и встреча со знакомой  (Male Principles and Running into an Acquaintance)
scenes.summary: Viktor Petrovich tells Elena he refuses to depend on a woman by living in her home, while at the restaurant Nastya is stunned to see her old acquaintance Katya.

scenes.title: Хвастовство невесты Кати  (Bride-to-Be Katya Shows Off)
scenes.summary: Katya brags to Nastya about her upcoming wedding at Claude Monet hosted by Dmitriy Nagiyev and asks whether Nastya has gotten married yet.

scenes.title: Требование пойти в ЗАГС  (Demanding a Trip to the Registry Office)
scenes.summary: Stung by Katya's questions, Nastya demands that Kostya go with her to the registry office tomorrow, while Kostya insists on making a proper romantic proposal first.

scenes.title: Речь Макса о лучшем ресторане  (Max's Speech About the Best Restaurant)
scenes.summary: When Chef Barinov tries to throw Max out of the kitchen again, Max passionately explains that he only wants to work at Claude Monet to learn from the best chef in Moscow.

scenes.title: Игнор от Елены и свадебный конверт  (Ignored by Elena and the Wedding Envelope)
scenes.summary: Unmoved by Max's speech, Chef Barinov sends him away and fumes when Elena rejects his phone calls right as the wedding clients arrive to discuss the menu.

scenes.title: Удар по самолюбию и правки в меню  (Wounded Pride and Menu Adjustments)
scenes.summary: Elena calls Viktor Petrovich back only to tell him she refuses to depend on men, leaving the Chef completely distracted as the wedding clients request changes to their menu.

scenes.title: Память как у слона  (A Memory Like an Elephant)
scenes.summary: Brooding over Elena, Chef Barinov barely listens to the wedding menu changes and writes nothing down, boasting to Vika and the clients that he has a memory like an elephant.

scenes.title: Возвращённый букет  (The Returned Bouquet)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov sends a bouquet of flowers to Elena Pavlovna as a peace offering, only for the courier to return with cash from Elena paying for the unwanted flowers.

scenes.title: Макс в роли гостя и гордость Насти  (Max Poses as a Guest and Nastya's Pride)
scenes.summary: Max sits at a dining room table pretending to be a guest so Chef Barinov has to come out and speak with him, while Nastya tells Vika not to help Kostya propose.

scenes.title: Тарелки на счастье  (Smashing Plates for Good Luck)
scenes.summary: As the wedding banquet begins, an enthusiastic guest keeps smashing restaurant plates on the floor for good luck, while Kostya warns Max not to let the Chef catch him.

scenes.title: Тост Нагиева и хитрость Насти  (Nagiyev's Toast and Nastya's New Tactic)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev invites the wedding guests to their tables while mixing up the groom's patronymic, and Nastya unsettles Kostya by suddenly showering him with tender praise.

scenes.title: Разговор на воздухе  (A Talk Outside in the Fresh Air)
scenes.summary: Spooked by Nastya's sweetness, Kostya begs the cooks for help, while Senya and Fedya convince Chef Barinov to step outside and hear Max out one last time.

scenes.title: Забытое меню и гнев Нагиева  (The Forgotten Menu and Nagiyev's Fury)
scenes.summary: The wedding banquet hits a crisis when Nagiyev storms in asking where the special dishes are, forcing Chef Barinov to admit that he forgot to write down the menu changes.

scenes.title: Обещание Макса выиграть час  (Max Promises to Buy an Hour)
scenes.summary: When Chef Barinov admits the kitchen lacks both the foie gras and the time to cook the missing wedding dishes, Max steps in and promises to buy them a full hour.

scenes.title: Шеф идёт на поклон к Елене  (The Chef Swallows His Pride with Elena)
scenes.summary: Desperate for foie gras and extra hands to save the wedding banquet, Chef Barinov goes to Elena Pavlovna to admit he was wrong and ask for her help.

scenes.title: Подмога от Елены и найденная невеста  (Reinforcements from Elena and the Found Bride)
scenes.summary: Viktor Petrovich confesses to Elena that after three failed marriages he is simply afraid of rushing in and making another mistake, and Elena brings her cooks to save the banquet just as Max finds the bride.

scenes.title: Музыкальный сюрприз и песня для Насти  (A Musical Surprise and a Song for Nastya)
scenes.summary: With the bride back at the table and the foie gras served, Nagiyev announces a musical gift from the staff of Claude Monet, and Kostya sings a romantic ballad for Nastya.

scenes.title: Предложение Кости и благодарность Шефа  (Kostya's Proposal and the Chef's Gratitude)
scenes.summary: Kostya proposes to Nastya on stage during the wedding reception, and back in the kitchen Chef Barinov thanks Max for saving the banquet but still refuses to rehire him as a cook.

scenes.title: Новый официант Максим Лавров  (New Waiter Maxim Lavrov)
scenes.summary: Max reflects on fighting for a happy ending as Nastya reveals to Kostya that they are expecting a baby, and Vika introduces Max to the dining room staff as their newest waiter.
